raw_response:
I will keep my land arranged around what I know best and what my family can manage steadily. I have 8 mu, and because my main system is wheat-maize and I have well irrigation, I will still put most of the land into that rotation because it is the safest way for me to keep grain coming in. I will use improved or hybrid seed on the grain crops because I want stable yield, and I will keep fertilizer at a moderate level so I do not spend too much but still feed the crop. I will leave a smaller part of the land for cotton and watermelon. Cotton gives me another source of cash, but it needs more pest control and more labor, so I will not expand it too much. Watermelon can bring cash early, and with irrigation I can support it, but I will only plant a small area because it needs careful management. I will use rotary tillage on most fields because it fits my conditions and saves labor better than deep ploughing every time. I will irrigate wheat, maize, and watermelon according to their water demand, and cotton a bit less. I will manage pests more often in cotton and watermelon, and less often in wheat and maize. My goal this year is steady grain, some cash income, and labor use my household can actually handle.
